name: Google Sheets
enables: Record approved enquiries and read permitted business records.
prepare: Spreadsheet link, tab names, column headings and 3 fictional example rows.
A unique record ID; required fields; who can view or update each field.
An authorised Google account owner and agreed access permissions.
Retention rules and the human contact to handle failed updates.
excludes: No automatic access to every tab. Sensitive student or patient records require identity verification and separately approved access controls.

name: Google Calendar
bots: ClinicGPT, BusinessGPT, eduGPT and appointment workflows
enables: Check availability and manage appointments within the approved booking workflow.
prepare: Calendar owner and calendar ID, plus the authorised account for connection.
Appointment types, duration, time zone, opening hours and blocked times.
Buffers, capacity, cancellation and rescheduling rules.
Required customer details and a safe test slot approved by the calendar owner.
excludes: A calendar connection alone does not supply patient history, payments or hotel room inventory. A booking is confirmed only after the provider verifies success.

name: Google Sheets + Calendar
bots: ClinicGPT, eduGPT and BusinessGPT scheduling with records
enables: Keep appointment records linked to calendar bookings using an agreed unique reference.
prepare: Both spreadsheet/tab details and calendar owner/ID; use fictional sample records.
Map the unique booking ID, customer fields, appointment time and status columns.
Define which system is authoritative for availability and booking status.
Agree booking, cancellation, retry and reconciliation behaviour; approve a test slot.
excludes: This is a combined workflow, not two independently confirmed bookings. Medical/student histories and identity checks require explicit additional scope. Do not assume both individual fees automatically cover synchronisation.

name: Razorpay
bots: FlowCart and approved payment workflows across the bot family
enables: Initiate agreed payment requests and verify provider-confirmed payment status.
prepare: Authorised Razorpay account administrator and account activation status.
Purpose, currency, approved amounts, order reference and receipt requirements.
Document the cancellation/refund policy and who may authorise refunds.
Arrange secure test credentials and webhook configuration during assisted setup; never email secrets.
excludes: No payment is treated as successful from a browser redirect alone. Automated refunds and custom settlement logic need separate approval. Standard Razorpay onboarding is included only within the INR 4,500 WhatsApp setup scope; do not pay twice for the same agreed work.

name: Shopify / WooCommerce
enables: Read approved catalogue/order information and perform only the agreed store actions.
prepare: Store URL, platform name/version and authorised store administrator.
API access availability, required permissions and a sandbox or safe test store.
Product variants, stock source, shipping/tax rules and sample fictional order IDs.
Decide read-only vs write actions, customer verification, cancellation and returns rules.
excludes: No full store migration, theme development or unrestricted order access. Checkout, refunds, stock writes and custom plugins require explicit scope and acceptance tests.

name: PMS / Channel Manager
enables: Use provider-authorised room availability and reservation actions when certified for your property.
prepare: Vendor/product name, property ID, account owner and vendor technical contact.
Official API documentation, API plan eligibility and sandbox access if available.
Room/rate mappings, occupancy, taxes, cancellation policies and source of truth.
Permitted reservation actions and vendor-approved test data; no guest database by email.
excludes: Not every vendor offers API access. Certification, vendor charges, custom mappings and multi-property work may change the quotation. A website crawl cannot establish live availability.

name: CRM / Custom API
fee: CRM INR 5,000-8,000; custom API INR 8,000-15,000 indicative
enables: Read or update specifically approved CRM records and business actions.
prepare: Vendor, account owner, official API documentation and sandbox details.
Record types, field mappings, unique IDs and fictional sample requests/responses.
Authorised read/write actions, identity checks and permission boundaries.
API limits, failure contact, retry rules and measurable acceptance criteria.
excludes: No unrestricted database access or arbitrary actions. Complex custom APIs, vendor certification and ongoing maintenance are separately scoped.
